chunks: It is narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
Everything is unrestricted until a prohibition regarding it is issued.

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the source of the hadith
key_terms.شَيْءٍ: thing; any matter or object under consideration
key_terms.كُلُّ: every or all, indicating general scope
key_terms.مُطْلَقٌ: unrestricted or left open, meaning not prohibited
key_terms.نَهْيٌ: prohibition; a forbidding ruling or command

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia hadith basis for the principle that everything is permissible unless prohibited?
ai.summary: This hadith states a foundational principle in fiqh: things are considered unrestricted and permissible unless a prohibition is established concerning them. It is significant as a concise expression of the presumption of permissibility in the absence of evidence for forbiddance.
